name: Norm Performance
description: Performance reviews, review cycles and capability frameworks — runs on Norm.
purpose: The management surface for performance: each review's manager side, the review meeting, the goals email and the pay decision; every review for HR admins; review cycles that create each round's reviews; the managers' daily digest; and the capability frameworks reviews rate against. Ported from Orbit. Its data sits in the shared HR namespace beside Norm Training's people, whose managers decide who completes each review.

components.label: Performance
components.description: Performance reviews (my team's and, for HR admins, every review), review cycles, capability frameworks and the review emails.

inputs.view: Which tab to open: 'my_team' (default — reviews you manage), 'all' (every review, HR admins), 'cycles', 'frameworks' or 'emails'.
inputs.review: A performance review, by id — opens it (as its manager when that's you).
